'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] strongly condemns the [[United States]] and [[European Union|European nations]] for making "zero response" to the [[Russia]]n deployment of [[Korean People's Army|North Korean soldiers]] against [[Ukraine]]. *[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Beqaa Valley airstrikes]]
***At least six [[Emergency medical responder|medics]] are killed and four others are wounded in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israel]]i attacks on areas in [[Duris, Lebanon|Duris]] and around the ancient city of [[Baalbek]] in the [[Beqaa Valley]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/31/israeli-strikes-in-southern-lebanon-kill-six-medics-as-truce-talks-continue (Al Jazeera)]
**A [[Hezbollah]] missile barrage kills at least seven people and critically injures another near [[Metula]] in [[Northern District (Israel)|northern Israel]]. Four of the victims are foreign [[agricultural worker]]s and two are [[Arab citizens of Israel|Israeli Arabs]]. '''International relations'''
*[[Germany–Iran relations]], [[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**[[Germany]] orders all three [[Iran]]ian [[consulate]]s in the country to close in response to the [[execution]] of Iranian-German prisoner [[Jamshid Sharmahd]], who was [[kidnap]]ped by [[Government of Iran|Iranian agents]] in [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], in 2020. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Assassination of Marielle Franco]]
**A court in [[Brazil]] sentences two former [[Military Police (Brazil)|Military Police]] officers to 59 and 78 years in prison respectively for the assassination of [[Rio de Janeiro]] [[Municipal Chamber of Rio de Janeiro|city councilor]] and [[human rights activist]] [[Marielle Franco]] in 2018. [https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-judge-sentences-ex-cops-over-marielle-franco-killing/a-70656556 (DW)]

**The [[Parliament of Fiji|Parliament]] of [[Fiji]] elects incumbent Speaker [[Naiqama Lalabalavu]] as the [[President of Fiji|President]] following the withdrawal of incumbent President [[Wiliame Katonivere]].
